steps.title: Review safety boundaries
steps.instructions: Identify an official source and decide what evidence can be shared safely.
steps.expectedResult: No seed phrase or private key is exposed.

steps.title: Install from a verified source
steps.instructions: Install from the official website or trusted app store.
steps.expectedResult: The wallet opens at its create/import screen.

steps.title: Create and back up
steps.instructions: Create a wallet and complete an offline recovery phrase backup.
steps.expectedResult: Wallet created with a phrase stored offline, not in screenshots, email, or cloud notes.

steps.title: Verify a receive address
steps.instructions: Open Receive and confirm the asset and network before copying the public address.
steps.expectedResult: A public receive address is visible without exposing recovery material.
